info.name: Financial API Validation - MFAPI NAV
info.description: Public mutual-fund NAV API checks. Uses no credentials. Update scheme_code if the example scheme is unavailable.

item.name: Get scheme metadata and NAV history

request.description: Fetches scheme metadata and historical NAV observations from MFAPI.in.

exec: pm.test('Response content type is JSON', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').to.include('application/json'); });
pm.test('Response body parses as JSON', function () { body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('Metadata object exists', function () { pm.expect(body).to.have.property('meta'); pm.expect(body.meta).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('Scheme name is a non-empty string', function () { pm.expect(body.meta.scheme_name).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('NAV history is a non-empty array', function () { pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });

pm.test('NAV observations contain date and positive numeric NAV', function () { body.data.forEach(function (row) { pm.expect(row).to.have.property('date'); pm.expect(String(row.date)).to.not.equal(''); pm.expect(Number(row.nav)).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(Number(row.nav)).to.be.above(0); }); });
pm.test('NAV observation dates are unique', function () { const dates = body.data.map(function (row) { return row.date; }); pm.expect(new Set(dates).size).to.eql(dates.length); });
pm.test('Response status is SUCCESS when supplied', function () { if (body.status !== undefined) pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('SUCCESS'); });
